newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to aim for upside target at 4,780.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to aim for upside target at 4,780.

text.p: A slight change in market sentiment for the better on Wednesday should help the FTSE 100 index recover some of its losses of the past three days, so that an upside target of 4,780 is possible, technical analysts said.
Cyclical and defensive stocks may fair better than financials today, but the pace and breadth will be lacking so that a large scale improvement by the market may not be possible, they added.
And it's possible that profit-taking will occur from 4,785.
By 0724 GMT, at the pre-market open, the FTSE was indicated up 7.3 at 4,765.8.
A tick chart of the index over the past three days shows the market undergoing a gradual decline, creating a downward channel from parallel trendlines connecting the intra-day peaks and troughs.
These trendlines are 65 points apart to the vertical, so it is possible for the index to have a similar trading range on a daily basis, analysts said.

On Tuesday, the FTSE made the normal one-third retracement of the rise to its intra-day high of 4,879.0 last Friday from its low of 4,538.3 on June 24. And with Wall Street in jubilant mood, this improves the chances of a small bounce by the FTSE.
On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average leapt up 103.82 points to 7,962.31.
